title: Drop and Debt
author: Theo Okonkwo
blurb: Coral Hartwell, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
